previous_release.scope: Anomaly inquiry (detect, test hypotheses against the data, ask a named person for a one-sentence answer) and human-approved healing re-applied before every engine. Nothing is removed, and nothing changes without an answer.
previous_release.business_logic_change_note: No engine, rule, grade or authority changed. A new tolerant stage 21 applies only repairs a person approved (none by default; then the mart differs only by an empty HEALED_FIELDS column). A new tolerant stage 96 detects anomalies and writes questions to extras and the trust snapshot. All 1426 pre-existing tests unchanged and green; 40 new tests.
key_changes: gsi/trust/anomaly.py: VALUE_OUTLIER, CATEGORY_VARIANT, NEW_CATEGORY, VOLUME_DROP, TOO_GOOD at entity grain, each with evidence-ranked hypotheses; 'it is real' always offered and leads on ties
gsi/trust/inquiry.py: append-only answer register in wh_audit; every answer needs a name and a sentence; 'we don't know' capped at 30 days then overdue; revoke instead of delete; CLI
